design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., #003366) for table headers and pull-quote rule.
Tables should have hairline borders, left-aligned text in first column, right-aligned numbers.
Pull-quote: large serif font, italic, with a thin rule above and below, centred or left-aligned with a vertical bar.
Sidebar: box with a light background tint (e.g., #f5f5f5) and a thin border, placed after the 'The IPO' section.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: This client concentration is the defining feature of the business.

pull_quotes.rationale: Single most important risk; a sharp, memorable number that the prose cannot isolate.
